content.short: Badger Finance is a decentralized autonomous organization that brings Bitcoin into DeFi and enables BTC deposits to earn yield.
content.description: Badger Finance is a decentralized autonomous organization focused on bringing Bitcoin into the DeFi ecosystem. With Badger as its native token, the project enables Bitcoin holders to participate in yield generation within a DeFi framework. The platform functions as a yield-earning service where users can deposit BTC to earn interest over time, providing a straightforward path to passive income by earning returns on Bitcoin within DeFi.
